client.name: Elaine Tan
client.background: Elaine Tan runs a family-owned distribution business and handles her personal investments separately from business finances. She is familiar with investment funds but less comfortable assessing emerging-market credit conditions.
client.investment_objective: She wants income-oriented growth from her personal investment portfolio.
client.loss_attitude: She is willing to accept investment losses but is hesitant about sharp declines and worries that her cautious answers might prevent her from proceeding.

setting.call_reason: The client has asked for a brief telephone discussion about proceeding with a purchase of Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund after reviewing its general description.
setting.conversation_style: A concise, practical private-banking call in Singapore English. The client is decisive about proceeding but becomes tentative when discussing her comfort with losses.

final_product.description: Crest Emerging Markets Bond Fund is a pooled investment in emerging-market debt whose value depends on bond prices, issuer creditworthiness and market conditions.
concrete_risks: Emerging-market bond issuers may default or suffer credit downgrades, reducing the value of the fund's holdings.
Rising interest rates can lower the market value of bonds held by the fund.
Political disruption and weaker market liquidity can make underlying bonds difficult to sell at favourable prices.
final_product.recommendation_basis: The fund's exposure to interest-bearing emerging-market debt provides an income-oriented investment approach relevant to the client's preference for income-producing assets.

additional_discussion_topics: Preference for telephone contact rather than branch visits
